subject: Hobby session equipment question
text: Hi, I'd like to ask about the hobby session on Saturday. I'm available, but I need to confirm one practical point. I only own a basic camera and no tripod, so can I still take part in the hands-on exercise, or should I borrow equipment in advance? If there is a shared list of tools, please send it soon. I don't want to arrive unprepared and miss the portion where we compare photos. Also, if the session moves indoors, will the table layout allow us to view sample shots easily?
